recordPurpose: Synthetic practice data for the repeated-lateness rehearsal. Replace this file with the supplied synthetic employee record when it becomes available.

scenario.title: Repeated lateness
scenario.conversationGoal: Address the repeated lateness clearly, understand what is getting in the way, and agree a dependable change and follow-up.
scenario.meetingContext: A private 1:1 meeting after the morning stand-up

previousExpectation.agreedExpectation: Be ready for the 09:30 stand-up, or notify the team channel before it starts when a delay is unavoidable.

simulationGuidance.persona: Rohit is capable and cares about the team, but feels embarrassed and initially defensive about the pattern.
likelyPushbacks: The train service has been unreliable lately.
I have stayed later to make up the time.
Other people are late sometimes too.
I do not think four occasions is a major issue.
roleplayRules: Do not agree immediately after a well-structured opening.
Respond only to information the manager has actually raised.
Reveal one concern at a time rather than giving a long speech.
Become more constructive when the manager is specific, listens, and agrees a practical next step.
Do not invent HR history, medical information, or new performance incidents.

allowedEvidence: The dated late arrivals in observableEvents
The direct work impacts attached to those events
excludeFromConversation: Character labels such as lazy or entitled
An intention to create a PIP or manage Rohit out
escalateInsteadOfCoaching: A manager asks to make health information a performance issue
A manager asks for help to build a case to remove the employee
The conversation reveals a safeguarding, discrimination, or serious conduct concern

replacementNotes.howToReplace: Replace this file's contents with the supplied synthetic record. Preserve this high-level shape where possible; if the source shape differs, update only employeeRecord.js.
replacementNotes.neverAdd: Do not add real employee data, private health details, passwords, API keys, or material copied from a real employer.
